_comment: Advisories the npm audit gate (scripts/npm-audit-gate.mjs) lets through. Only for an advisory with NO patched version; the gate fails once a fix is published. Each entry needs the owner's decision and a reason.

advisories.reason: ReDoS through crafted extglob patterns; every version is affected and no fix exists yet. Whity only matches its own fixed patterns, never a pattern from outside.
